models.SECTOR: Top quartile of a fixed, complete official sector-index universe by 63-session relative return versus Nifty 500; worst rank for ties.
models.PEAD: Positive EPS surprise against consensus captured before announcement, observed within 20 completed post-announcement sessions. Seasonal forecasts remain separate diagnostics.
models.COMBINED: Secondary hypothesis requiring both sector leadership and consensus surprise; never silently replace either standalone model.

common.timing: Completed-bar breakout/pullback trigger; V1 EMA alignment/relative strength eligibility not inherited; RVOL recorded, no new RVOL threshold.
common.risk: Existing bounded entry, fixed fractional risk, cash, total risk, sector, position and correlation caps; surveillance CLEAR required at observation and next-session open.
common.observation: 18:00 IST; source publication and ingestion must both precede observation. Historical downloads are not prospective observations.
common.breadth: Fraction of available snapshot stocks above 200-session SMA, valid denominator and coverage recorded; not claimed Nifty-500 population breadth.
common.default_exit: FIXED structural initial stop and target; 40-session PEAD cap is a research parameter, not an optimal holding-period claim.

secondary_individual_ablations: Available-universe breadth above 50%, at least 90% coverage
India VIX below median of previous 126 sessions excluding today
5-session delivery fraction, quantity and turnover above prior 20-session values
Highest held close minus 2 ATR, updated after close for next session
Highest held high minus 3 ATR, updated after close for next session

evaluation.primary: Net mean R and exposure-matched benchmark excess NAV, separately for sector and PEAD models, after modeled costs.
evaluation.interval: Entry-month cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261002, 95% interval; intervals do not correct multiple comparisons.
evaluation.inconclusive: Fewer than 40 closed trades or six entry months per model; unavailable feeds, incomplete index rank universe or unverified timestamp/coverage provenance.
evaluation.comparison: Same price universe, dates, capital, costs and portfolio limits; retain all variants, do not pick a retrospective winner.
evaluation.freeze: Protocol hash, settings, execution parameters, price snapshot and feed hashes retained. Freeze data-provider coverage and sector universe before prospective observation. Changes start a new version.

limitations: Current constituent subset is not point-in-time; missing/delisted stock prices remain unresolved.
No licensed data acquisition is included. Local timestamps do not by themselves prove historical availability.
Daily fills do not establish price-band, auction or broker feasibility. Partial live fills are not implemented.
Earnings EPS must use consistent currency, share adjustments and consolidated/standalone accounting basis; framework cannot certify these from supplied numbers.
Delivery volume is an accumulation proxy, not identification of institutions.
No trading strategy is promoted or enabled automatically.
